overall_rationale: Three of five candidates are strongly NCERT-grounded (Physics kinetic temperature, Zoology levels of organisation, Physics work–energy numerical). Two candidates (Chemistry protein denaturation Anfinsen-style protocol; Botany streptomycin/Streptomyces/secondary-metabolite claims) contain substantial material claims that are NCERT_EVIDENCE_NOT_LOCATED in the exact canonical PDFs. No incorrect keyed answer was found among the three PASS candidates, and no scientific contradiction was found in those three; the gate fails because not all five pass and unsupported content in the 'correct' options of Chem/Botany is substantial.
provider_recommendation: Do not treat OpenAI gpt-5-mini as cleared for unsupervised NCERT-pilot generation of the remaining 271. Retain for generation with mandatory independent NCERT verification and prompt/constraint hardening to forbid non-NCERT experimental protocols and unnamed antibiotic enrichment. Physics/Zoology fidelity in this sample is strong.
